assumptions: kb_rules_path shapeup/knowledge-base/task-executor.md does not exist; no team rules were applied
When both files are missing the envfile is read first (UC steps 2 then 3), so only `cannot read <envfile>` is reported
`--schema=x`, a duplicate `--schema`, a trailing `--schema` with no value, and any other `-`-prefixed token are all USAGE (exit 2)
Parse problems and line-bearing findings are merged and stable-sorted by line, so a type finding followed by an enum finding on one line keeps evaluate() order
A non-JSON schema's reason is the literal `not valid JSON` (UC step 4); each validateSchema message goes on its own stderr line
An unexpected error prints `envlint: <message>` with whitespace collapsed to one line; the exit code is set through process.exitCode, never process.exit()
Tests write their fixtures under os.tmpdir(); test/fixtures/cli/ was not needed
